high_level_description: The image showcases a wooden dining set from the brand "Woodsworth." The setting appears to be a well-lit room with a modern and elegant design. The furniture is made of wood, featuring a rectangular dining table with a rich, warm tone and four matching chairs. Each chair has a unique backrest design with an X-shaped pattern, adding a touch of sophistication to the set. The table is positioned centrally, surrounded by the chairs, suggesting it is ready for use. The background includes a textured wall with a subtle greenish hue, which complements the wooden tones of the furniture.
